core: Peroxisomal protein import and peroxisome fission
qualifier: with pexophagy, without TYSND1 processing
name: Peroxisomal matrix/membrane protein import, fission and pexophagy
rationale: All members concern peroxisome protein targeting/import, fission, pexophagy or the peroxisome gene set; unlike the larger twin it lacks TYSND1 cleavage, docking and unfolding, and unlike the fatty-acid confusables it has pexophagy.

qualifier: with TYSND1 matrix protein processing and membrane docking
name: Peroxisomal import with TYSND1 processing, docking and pexophagy
rationale: Members cover peroxisome protein import, fission and pexophagy; what sets it apart from its subset twin is TYSND1 cleavage of imported proteins, protein-to-membrane docking and unfolding.

qualifier: including phenylketonuria
name: Phenylalanine and tyrosine metabolism including phenylketonuria
rationale: All members are phenylalanine/tyrosine metabolic or catabolic terms; phenylketonuria and phenylalanine metabolism distinguish it from the tyrosine-catabolism-only theme, and it lacks the general amino acid catabolism terms of the larger theme.

qualifier: as the phenylalanine degradation route
name: Tyrosine catabolic route of phenylalanine degradation
rationale: The three members are tyrosine catabolism and phenylalanine metabolism, a narrow core lacking the phenylketonuria and general amino acid terms of its confusables.

qualifier: within general L-amino acid and amide catabolism
name: Phenylalanine/tyrosine breakdown within general amino acid catabolism
rationale: Members combine phenylalanine/tyrosine metabolism and phenylketonuria with broad L-amino acid and amide catabolic terms, which the smaller phenylalanine-tyrosine themes lack.

core: Positive regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity
qualifier: including anti-tumor NK response
name: Positive regulation of NK/T cell tumor cytotoxicity
rationale: All three members are positive regulation of NK or T cell-mediated killing, including the NK response to tumor cells, without the NK/T transcriptional signatures or cytokine production of the larger theme.

core: NK and T cell cytotoxic activation
qualifier: with NK/T cell blood transcriptional signatures
name: NK/T cell cytotoxicity with blood NK and T signatures
rationale: Members combine positive regulation of NK/T cytotoxicity and NK cytokine production with NK- and T-cell-enriched blood gene signatures, which the GO-only subset and the inhibitory-receptor confusables lack.

qualifier: with excitatory and inhibitory potential regulation, no glutamatergic transmission
name: Excitatory and inhibitory postsynaptic scaffold clustering and potential regulation
rationale: Members cover neurexin-neuroligin-driven postsynaptic assembly, PSD-95, gephyrin, GABA and NMDA receptor clustering and regulation of excitatory/inhibitory potentials; it lacks the glutamatergic transmission terms of its superset and has inhibitory-synapse terms the adhesion confusables lack.

qualifier: with enhanced glutamatergic neuron-neuron transmission
name: Postsynaptic clustering with enhanced glutamatergic synaptic transmission
rationale: Members cover PSD-95, gephyrin, GABA and NMDA receptor clustering and postsynaptic potential regulation; the added neuron-neuron and glutamatergic transmission terms distinguish it from its subset twin and from the synaptic-adhesion confusables.

qualifier: with glycine synthesis and glyoxylate metabolism
name: Proline turnover with glycine and glyoxylate metabolism
rationale: Members are proline biosynthesis/catabolism, glycine biosynthesis, glyoxylate and general amino acid terms; it lacks the organic acid metabolism terms of its superset and the threonine/tyrosine terms of other confusables.

qualifier: within broader organic acid synthesis and catabolism
name: Proline and glycine–glyoxylate metabolism within organic acid turnover
rationale: Members combine proline, glycine and glyoxylate metabolism with general organic acid biosynthetic/catabolic terms, which distinguish it from its subset twin; it lacks the glycine-conjugation and threonine terms of other confusables.

core: Pyrimidine nucleotide synthesis, salvage and catabolism
qualifier: with deoxynucleoside monophosphate turnover
name: Pyrimidine de novo, salvage and dNMP turnover
rationale: Members cover de novo and salvage pyrimidine synthesis, pyrimidine catabolism and dNMP synthesis/catabolism; it lacks the purine deoxyribonucleoside and NDP-NTP interconversion terms of its superset and the purine de novo terms of another confusable.

qualifier: with purine deoxynucleoside turnover and NDP–NTP interconversion
name: Pyrimidine and purine deoxynucleotide metabolism with NDP–NTP interconversion
rationale: Members span pyrimidine synthesis, salvage and catabolism plus deoxyribonucleotide turnover; purine deoxyribonucleoside metabolism, deoxyribonucleotide catabolism and nucleotide di-/triphosphate interconversion distinguish it from its subset twin.

core: Receptor-mediated virion attachment and endocytic entry
qualifier: with induced cell-cell fusion
name: Receptor-mediated virion attachment, endocytic entry and syncytium induction
rationale: All members describe receptor-mediated virus binding, entry and induction of cell-cell fusion; it lacks the Dengue and RSV entry terms of its superset and the influenza/viral regulation terms of other confusables.

qualifier: including Dengue and RSV entry and Dengue virion release
name: Receptor-mediated viral entry including Dengue and RSV
rationale: Members cover receptor-mediated virion attachment, endocytosis and cell-cell fusion plus Dengue and RSV attachment/entry and Dengue virion assembly/release, which its subset twin lacks; it lacks the viral entry regulation and protein maturation terms of other confusables.

core: Recombinational DNA repair by strand invasion
qualifier: via synthesis-dependent strand annealing and crosslink repair
name: Strand-invasion repair via strand annealing, sister exchange, crosslink repair
rationale: Members cover strand invasion, SDSA, sister chromatid exchange, interstrand crosslink repair and repair synthesis; it lacks the break-induced replication, unwinding and polymerase regulation of its superset and the NHEJ/BRCA terms of other confusables.

core: Recombinational DNA repair by strand invasion
qualifier: with break-induced replication and repair polymerase activation
name: Recombinational repair with break-induced replication and polymerase activation
rationale: Members cover strand invasion, SDSA and crosslink repair; break-induced replication, DNA unwinding and positive regulation of DNA polymerase activity distinguish it from its subset twin, and it lacks NHEJ and checkpoint terms of other confusables.

core: Regulation of leukocyte adhesion to endothelium
qualifier: via adhesion molecule production, without diapedesis
name: Leukocyte–endothelial adhesion control via adhesion molecule production
rationale: All four members regulate leukocyte binding to (arterial) vascular endothelium, extravasation or adhesion molecule production; it lacks the diapedesis and neutrophil/T cell extravasation terms of its superset and the monocyte/inflammatory terms of other confusables.

qualifier: with diapedesis and neutrophil/T cell transmigration
name: Leukocyte adhesion, diapedesis and neutrophil/T cell extravasation
rationale: Members regulate leukocyte-endothelial adhesion and extravasation; diapedesis, neutrophil migration and neutrophil/T cell extravasation distinguish it from its subset twin and from the monocyte- and integrin-focused confusables.

qualifier: D- and E-series, without conjugates or HETEs
name: D- and E-series resolvin and protectin biosynthesis
rationale: All members are biosyntheses of D/E-series resolvins, protectins and DPA-derived SPMs; it lacks the tissue-regeneration conjugates, oxo-derivatives and HETE synthesis of its superset and the lipoxin/arachidonate terms of other confusables.

qualifier: including tissue-regeneration conjugates and HETE precursors
name: Pro-resolving mediators with regenerative conjugates and HETE synthesis
rationale: Members span resolvin, protectin and maresin biosynthesis; MCTR/PCTR/RCTR conjugates, 13-series resolvins, oxo-derivatives and 5-/15-HETE synthesis distinguish it from its subset twin, and it lacks the lipoxin/leukotriene terms of other confusables.

qualifier: with Pol III 5S rRNA and nucleolar epigenetic regulation
name: Pol I/III rRNA transcription with nucleolar epigenetic control
rationale: Members cover the Pol I transcription cycle, 5S rRNA transcription by Pol III and NoRC/B-WICH/SIRT1/CSB chromatin regulation; it lacks the MYC targets and early pre-rRNA cleavage of its superset and the tRNA/snRNA Pol III terms of other confusables.

qualifier: with MYC targets and early pre-rRNA cleavage
name: MYC-driven rRNA transcription and early pre-rRNA cleavage
rationale: Members cover Pol I transcription and nucleolar chromatin control; MYC target sets, 5'-ETS/ITS1 cleavage, rRNA 5'-end processing and nucleolar localization distinguish it from its subset twin, and it lacks the translation initiation terms of another confusable.

qualifier: with restraint of erythroid and granulocyte fates in myeloid progenitors
name: RUNX1 megakaryocyte–platelet commitment restraining erythroid and granulocyte fates
rationale: Members cover RUNX1-driven megakaryocyte/platelet development, myeloid progenitor proliferation and negative regulation of erythroid and granulocyte differentiation; it lacks the granulopoiesis and monocyte/macrophage restraint terms of its superset and the erythropoiesis terms of other confusables.

qualifier: with granulopoiesis control and monocyte–macrophage restraint
name: RUNX1 megakaryopoiesis and granulopoiesis with monocyte–macrophage restraint
rationale: Members cover RUNX1-driven megakaryocyte development and myeloid progenitor differentiation; transcriptional regulation of granulopoiesis and negative regulation of monocyte and macrophage differentiation distinguish it from its subset twin, and it lacks the erythroid and HSC terms of other confusables.
